def: Shalem, an early name of Jerusalem

occurrences.text: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan–aram; and pitched his tent before the city.
In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
